legs.note: With submit the field is committed and the page moves on, so the receipt is the navigation that followed; textAppeared is a fill WITHOUT a submit. ROUND 1: the class no longer asserts an affordance. The fill verb reaches a row the reading called a field even when it did not mark it fillable, and the press verb reaches a named candidate — what matters is which ROW was reached, not the reading's confidence about it.
legs.say: type alpine touring boots into the search box and press return

summary: Typing into a field the page drew, and proving the text is in it.
